source.title: Using the WSPR Mode for Antenna Performance Evaluation and Propagation Assessment on the 160-m Band
source.page_numbering: Printed article page N is PDF page N+1 in the TU Delft repository copy because of its cover page.
source.evidence_location: Section 3 and Figure 1, printed page 3; calibration narrative in Section 4, printed pages 4-5.

published_calibration.confirmation_timing: A later separate period; no calendar dates or gap given.
published_calibration.antenna_setup: Both RTL receiver chains connected to one ITA LWA II 20 m long-wire antenna through a -6 dB splitter.
published_calibration.receiver_conditions: Same computer and WSJT settings, hardware and audio AGC disabled, matched 25 m coaxial cables, chokes, and VNA-matched band-pass filters.
published_calibration.station_threshold_wording: More than 50 receptions during the seven-day calibration; exact pairing and counting procedure not specified.
published_calibration.statistic_wording: Average difference or average deviation; not identified as a median.

comparison_policy.rounding_assumption: Conventional nearest-one-decimal comparison band around the displayed 1.2 dB average. This is a declared comparison policy, not published measurement uncertainty or a confidence interval.
comparison_policy.archive_statistic: Pooled same-transmitter/full-locator/same-120-second-cycle ON4AWM0 minus ON4AWM1 SNR differences after fixed demo eligibility.
comparison_policy.direction_basis: The signed Target-minus-Reference direction is defined by the archive reconstruction; the paper does not identify a signed offset for the named receiver callsigns.
comparison_policy.threshold_relation: Paper literally specifies >50; demo uses >=50. The frozen independent archive calculation confirms no peer identity has exactly 50 joint observations, so both thresholds select the same peers for this corpus.
comparison_policy.population_boundary: The chosen February 6-13, 2021 seven-day archive window is not independently authenticated as either original seven-day publication dataset.
comparison_policy.independent_expected_values: Exact archive counts, means, medians, quartiles, sample spread, per-station values, histogram and temporal cells are calculated from frozen raw reports, not inferred from the paper's rounded 1.2 dB value.
comparison_policy.temporal_policy: Seven 24-hour intervals anchored to the chosen window start at 06:00 UTC. The publication does not provide this temporal curve.

excluded_as_calibration_anchors: Figures 5-7 compare separate antennas and their orientations; they do not publish common-input calibration timestamps.
Figures 8-9 and Table 1 concern two separate perpendicular shorted dipoles and an approximately 3 dB orientation difference, not the 1.2 dB receiver-chain calibration.
Generic UTC WSPR protocol timing does not establish calendar endpoints for the calibration.
